name: marko/health
description: Health check interfaces and infrastructure for Marko Framework

suggest.marko/cache: Needed by CacheHealthCheck (cache read/write check); install a cache driver too
suggest.marko/database: Needed by DatabaseHealthCheck (database connectivity check); install a database driver too
suggest.marko/filesystem: Needed by FilesystemHealthCheck (filesystem write/delete check); install a filesystem driver too
